versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- Version 1.0.3 has no updates or modifications from the previous release.

- Added explicit instructions to always inform users of the endpoint and estimated cost before making any paid call and to wait for explicit user approval; autonomous spending is now prohibited.
- Declared storage of the wallet private key at `~/.clawxpay/wallet.key` (owner-only access, never transmitted).
- Documented spending rules: requires user approval for every transaction, specifies USDC on Base mainnet.
- No changes to API coverage or usage instructions.
- This update improves security, privacy transparency, and user control over spending.

clawxpay 1.0.1

- Wallet auto-generation on first install; manual private key configuration is no longer needed.
- Setup instructions updated: the package now creates and prints your wallet address during installation.
- Environment variable requirement removed; initial funding instructions now guide you to send USDC to the new wallet.
- Added `clawxpay-init` as a CLI utility for easier onboarding.

clawxpay 1.0.0

- Initial release of clawxpay skill.
- Provides unified pay-per-call access to 250+ APIs (crypto, US stocks, China A-share, Web3, and 7 AI model providers) via the x402 protocol.
- Requires only a Base chain wallet holding USDC; no accounts, API keys, or subscriptions needed.
- On-chain instant settlement using EIP-3009, with local signature and strong privacy.
- Supports professional market data, technical indicators, AI inference, and funding intelligence on a per-call basis from $0.001.
- Simple OpenClaw integration: set WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY and install the SDK.
